studies.title: Movable type
studies.caption: Bi Sheng prints with individual characters of baked clay, as recorded by Shen Kuo.
studies.prompt: Overhead close view of a Song Chinese printing workbench about1045CE: a hand sets small separate baked-clay character blocks into an iron frame on a board, spare clay types in shallow trays, ink and paper nearby. Uneven hand-cut glyph-like marks, no Latin alphabet or Gutenberg screw press.
